"import cadquery as cq

# Rectangular plate with corner fillets and bolt holes (all parameters hard-coded)
L = 120.0        # plate size along X
W = 80.0         # plate size along Y
T = 10.0         # thickness along Z (base face at z=0)
FILLET_R = 10.0  # fillet radius on all four Z-parallel (vertical) edges
HOLE_D = 8.0     # through-hole diameter
HOLE_X = 42.0    # hole center |x| coordinate
HOLE_Y = 22.0    # hole center |y| coordinate

# Reliable sequence: base plate -> fillet vertical edges FIRST -> then drill holes
part = (cq.Workplane("XY").rect(L, W).extrude(T)
        .edges("|Z").fillet(FILLET_R)
        .faces(">Z").workplane()
        .pushPoints([(HOLE_X, HOLE_Y),
                     (-HOLE_X, HOLE_Y),
                     (HOLE_X, -HOLE_Y),
                     (-HOLE_X, -HOLE_Y)])
        .circle(HOLE_D / 2.0)
        .cutThruAll())

solid = part.val()
cq.exporters.export(solid, "part.step")"
